requirement_text: System shall utilize help bubbles for assistance.
user_story: As a user, I want help bubbles to assist me, so that I get guidance where I need it.
technical_task: Add help bubbles to the interface that show assistance text for the elements they describe.
acceptance_criteria: Given an element that has help available, when the user asks for help, then a help bubble is displayed.
Given a help bubble is displayed, when the user dismisses it, then it is no longer shown.
rationale: Role assumed: user. Which elements get a bubble is not stated.

requirement_text: All events are logged (UC5) and the HCP remains on the office visit page to verify their changes (UC11).
user_story: As an HCP, I want all events to be logged and to stay on the office visit page to verify my changes, so that I can check them before leaving.
technical_task: Log every event (UC5) and keep the HCP on the office visit page after saving so the changes can be verified (UC11).
acceptance_criteria: Given any event occurs, when it happens, then it is logged.
Given an HCP has made changes, when the changes are saved, then the HCP remains on the office visit page and can verify them.
rationale: Role stated: HCP. The use case numbers are references only.

requirement_text: A clinical class shall specify the course name, lecture room requirements, clinical site needs, lecture instructor needs, and clinical lab instructor needs.
user_story: As a program coordinator, I want a clinical class to specify the course name, lecture room requirements, clinical site needs, lecture instructor needs and clinical lab instructor needs, so that the class can be planned.
technical_task: Define a clinical class record with fields for course name, lecture room requirements, clinical site needs, lecture instructor needs and clinical lab instructor needs.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new clinical class, when it is created, then the course name can be entered.
Given a clinical class, when its requirements are entered, then lecture room, clinical site, lecture instructor and clinical lab instructor needs can be specified.
rationale: Role assumed: program coordinator.

requirement_text: User shall access the main menu on the home screen, which includes options like "Care Give Support", "Track your Child", and "Hospital Information".
user_story: As a parent, I want to reach the main menu from the home screen with options such as Care Give Support, Track your Child and Hospital Information, so that I can find what I need.
technical_task: Place a main menu on the home screen offering at least the options Care Give Support, Track your Child and Hospital Information.
acceptance_criteria: Given the home screen, when the user opens it, then the main menu is accessible.
Given the main menu, when the user views it, then it includes Care Give Support, Track your Child and Hospital Information.
rationale: Role assumed: parent. "Options like" suggests the list may contain more.

requirement_text: These report the logical state of a signal as one of several values based on the discrete state of a controller signal.
rationale: The sentence refers to undefined items and describes no required behaviour.
clarification_questions: What must the system do with the logical state values?

requirement_text: The return process shall update the inventory system to reflect a decrease in the number of available medicines, ensuring accurate stock levels.
user_story: As a pharmacy manager, I want the return process to reduce the inventory count of available medicines, so that stock levels stay accurate.
technical_task: Update the inventory system when a return is processed so that the available medicine count reflects the decrease.
acceptance_criteria: Given a return is processed, when the process completes, then the inventory system is updated.
Given the inventory update, when the available medicines are viewed, then the number shown reflects the decrease.
rationale: Role assumed: pharmacy manager.

requirement_text: The delivery of the SIM-cards needs to start earlier with the needed lead time of the manufacturer of the communication unit (KOM-Modul).
rationale: "Earlier" and "the needed lead time" are not quantified, so the requirement cannot be tested.
clarification_questions: How much earlier should the delivery of the SIM-cards start?
What is the manufacturer's lead time?

requirement_text: User shall receive suggestions for existing apps matching their interests.
user_story: As a user, I want suggestions for existing apps that match my interests, so that I discover useful apps.
technical_task: Show suggested existing apps selected to match the user's interests.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user with known interests, when the user opens the suggestions, then existing apps matching those interests are shown.
Given a suggested app, when the user views it, then it relates to at least one of the user's interests.
rationale: Role assumed: user. How interests are determined is not stated.

requirement_text: When an event occurs, the THEMAS system shall identify the event type and format an appropriate event message. The THEMAS system shall record each event by a description and the c urrent system time for that event. This information shall be recorded in a Microsoft® Access® database that shall reside on the supervisor’s computer.
user_story: As a supervisor, I want the THEMAS system to identify each event type and record the event with a description and the system time, so that I have a history of events.
technical_task: On each event, identify the event type, build an event message, and store its description and the current system time in a Microsoft Access database on the supervisor's computer.
acceptance_criteria: Given an event occurs, when the THEMAS system handles it, then it identifies the event type and formats an appropriate event message.
Given an event has occurred, when it is recorded, then its description and the current system time are stored in a Microsoft Access database on the supervisor's computer.
rationale: Role assumed: supervisor. The garbled characters in the source around the product names were read as the Microsoft Access trademark.

requirement_text: The icons shall be according to the Android Icon Guidelines.
user_story: As a mobile user, I want the icons to follow the Android Icon Guidelines, so that they look familiar on my device.
technical_task: Design all icons to comply with the Android Icon Guidelines.
acceptance_criteria: Given an icon in the application, when it is reviewed against the Android Icon Guidelines, then it conforms.
Given the set of icons, when they are all reviewed, then none violates the guidelines.
rationale: Role assumed: mobile user. The guidelines themselves are not quoted.

requirement_text: The product shall allow the user to select a chosen language from one of the target market countries.
requirement_text_raw: The product shall allow the user to select a chosen language from one of the target market countries.'
user_story: As a customer, I want to select a language from those of the target market countries, so that I can use the product in my language.
technical_task: Provide a language selector limited to the languages of the target market countries.
acceptance_criteria: Given the product, when the user opens the language options, then the languages of the target market countries are offered.
Given a language is chosen, when the product is shown, then it uses the chosen language.
rationale: Role assumed: customer.

requirement_text: Provided the failed NE is in a recoverable state, recovery of a failed NE shall take no longer than 500 microseconds. This recovery requirement includes the time from which the FTSS software initiates the recovery to the time the recovery is complete.
requirement_text_raw: Provided the failed NE is in a recoverable state, recovery of a failed NE shall (3.2.2.4.11) take no longer than 500 microseconds.  This recovery requirement includes the time from which the FTSS software initiates the recovery to the time the recovery is complete.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want recovery of a failed NE to take no longer than 500 microseconds when it is in a recoverable state, so that failures are quickly masked.
technical_task: Limit recovery of a failed NE to 500 microseconds, measured from when the FTSS software initiates recovery to when recovery completes, provided the NE is in a recoverable state.
acceptance_criteria: Given a failed NE in a recoverable state, when the FTSS software initiates recovery, then recovery completes in no more than 500 microseconds.
Given the measured recovery time, when it is evaluated, then it covers the time from initiation to completion of the recovery.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer.

requirement_text: System shall list all sellers offering a common product and prioritize them based on the percentage of discount.
user_story: As a shopper, I want to see all sellers of a product ranked by percentage of discount, so that I can find the best offer.
technical_task: List every seller offering the same product, ordered by percentage of discount.
acceptance_criteria: Given a product offered by several sellers, when the shopper views the product, then all those sellers are listed.
Given the list of sellers, when it is displayed, then sellers are ordered by percentage of discount.
rationale: Role assumed: shopper. "Prioritize" is read as ordering, highest discount first, which is an interpretation.

requirement_text: Payment options shall include invoice or credit/debit card.
user_story: As a customer, I want to pay by invoice or credit/debit card, so that I can choose how I pay.
technical_task: Offer invoice and credit/debit card among the payment options at checkout.
acceptance_criteria: Given checkout, when the customer chooses a payment option, then invoice is available.
Given checkout, when the customer chooses a payment option, then credit/debit card is available.
rationale: Role assumed: customer. "Include" means other options may exist.

requirement_text: More details and network management signals or diagnostic signals are documented in the OEM Vehicle Message Matrix.
rationale: The sentence only points to another document.
clarification_questions: Which network management or diagnostic signals are meant?
Is the OEM Vehicle Message Matrix part of this requirement?

requirement_text: The application should be available at all working hours, with maintenance or backup operations conducted outside of working hours.
user_story: As an employee, I want the application to be available at all working hours, with maintenance and backups done outside them, so that I can work without interruption.
technical_task: Keep the application available during working hours and schedule maintenance and backup operations outside working hours.
acceptance_criteria: Given working hours, when a user opens the application, then it is available.
Given maintenance or backup operations, when they are scheduled, then they run outside working hours.
rationale: Role assumed: employee. The hours themselves are not given.

requirement_text: The system shall allow staff members to issue zoning-related permits upon eligibility and compliance.
user_story: As a staff member, I want to issue zoning-related permits when applicants are eligible and compliant, so that valid permits are granted.
technical_task: Allow staff to issue zoning-related permits once eligibility and compliance are confirmed.
acceptance_criteria: Given an applicant who is eligible and compliant, when staff issue a zoning-related permit, then the permit is issued.
Given an applicant who is not eligible or not compliant, when staff try to issue a permit, then it is not issued.
rationale: Role stated: staff member.

requirement_text: The system shall allow staff members to schedule meetings.
user_story: As a staff member, I want to schedule meetings, so that others know when to attend.
technical_task: Provide meeting scheduling for staff.
acceptance_criteria: Given the schedule, when a staff member creates a meeting, then it is saved in the schedule.
Given a scheduled meeting, when staff view the schedule, then the meeting is shown.
rationale: Role stated: staff member.

requirement_text: All input parameters are validated (including form fields query strings cookies and HTTP headers).
requirement_text_raw: All input parameters are validated (including form fields  query strings  cookies  and HTTP headers).
user_story: As a security engineer, I want all input parameters validated, including form fields, query strings, cookies and HTTP headers, so that malformed or hostile input is rejected.
technical_task: Validate every input parameter received, including form fields, query strings, cookies and HTTP headers.
acceptance_criteria: Given an input parameter from a form field, query string, cookie or HTTP header, when it is received, then it is validated.
Given an input that fails validation, when it is received, then it is rejected.
rationale: Role assumed: security engineer. The validation rules are not given.

requirement_text: A Data Consuming User shall be able to download data as CSV.
user_story: As a data consumer, I want to download data as CSV, so that I can use it in other tools.
technical_task: Add a CSV download option for data available to a Data Consuming User.
acceptance_criteria: Given data the user may access, when the user selects CSV download, then the data is downloaded as a CSV file.
Given the downloaded file, when it is opened, then it contains the data in CSV format.
rationale: Role stated: Data Consuming User.

requirement_text: The system shall give stable and reproducible results.
rationale: "Stable" and "reproducible" are not defined for any specific result.
clarification_questions: What does "stable" mean in measurable terms?
Under which conditions must results be reproducible?

requirement_text: Access is already installed on the editor's computer, which operates on the Windows operating system.
rationale: The sentence states an installed environment and describes no required behaviour.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement or a statement of the existing environment?
What must the system do on the editor's computer?

requirement_text: Upon selecting a category, the system shall show the corresponding content.
user_story: As a user, I want to see the content that belongs to a category when I select it, so that I can browse by category.
technical_task: Display the content that belongs to a category when the category is selected.
acceptance_criteria: Given a category, when the user selects it, then the corresponding content is shown.
Given two categories, when the user selects each, then each shows its own content.
rationale: Role assumed: user.

requirement_text: If a fuse is used for shut off of a short circuit, the fuse shall be located between cell 17 and cell 18 to ensure a disconnection of the half block of the battery.
user_story: As a battery engineer, I want a fuse used for short circuit shut-off to be located between cell 17 and cell 18, so that the half block of the battery is disconnected.
technical_task: Place the shut-off fuse between cell 17 and cell 18 so a short circuit disconnects the half block of the battery.
acceptance_criteria: Given a fuse is used for short-circuit shut-off, when the battery is assembled, then the fuse is located between cell 17 and cell 18.
Given a short circuit, when the fuse trips, then the half block of the battery is disconnected.
rationale: Role assumed: battery engineer.

requirement_text: Users shall be able to put a hold on selected seats for five minutes before finalizing and making payment.
user_story: As a customer, I want to hold selected seats for five minutes before finalizing payment, so that nobody else takes them while I pay.
technical_task: Reserve selected seats for five minutes while the user finalizes the booking and pays.
acceptance_criteria: Given seats the user has selected, when the user places a hold, then the seats are held for five minutes.
Given the five minutes have passed without payment, when the hold ends, then the seats are no longer held.
rationale: Role assumed: customer. Releasing the seats after the hold is an interpretation.

requirement_text: Similar to an administrator a software tester is added by directly entering the software tester into the database by an administrator that has access to the database.
requirement_text_raw: Similar to an administrator  a software tester is added by directly entering the software tester into the database by an administrator that has access to the database.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to add a software tester by entering them directly into the database, so that testers have access.
technical_task: Support adding a software tester by having an administrator with database access enter the tester into the database.
acceptance_criteria: Given an administrator with access to the database, when the administrator enters a software tester into the database, then the software tester is added.
Given a user without database access, when the user tries to add a software tester this way, then the tester is not added.
rationale: Role stated: administrator and software tester. The second criterion follows from "an administrator that has access".

requirement_text: System Administrators shall monitor message exchanges will predict and determine problems and will also provide internal and external support.
user_story: As a system administrator, I want to monitor message exchanges, predict and determine problems, and provide internal and external support, so that issues are resolved.
technical_task: Give System Administrators the ability to monitor message exchanges, to predict and determine problems, and to provide internal and external support.
acceptance_criteria: Given message exchanges, when a System Administrator monitors them, then the exchanges can be observed.
Given a problem in the exchanges, when the System Administrator investigates, then the problem can be determined and support provided.
rationale: Role stated: System Administrators. "Predict" is not detailed.

requirement_text: The electrical details of the connected head rest loads are described in the following chapters.
rationale: The sentence points ahead to other chapters and states no requirement.
clarification_questions: Which loads and chapters does the sentence mean?
What must the system or design do regarding the head rest loads?

requirement_text: Remove MID from being displayed on all pages and URLs.
user_story: As a security officer, I want the MID removed from every page and URL, so that it is not exposed.
technical_task: Stop showing the MID on all pages and in all URLs.
acceptance_criteria: Given any page, when it is displayed, then the MID is not shown.
Given any URL, when it is inspected, then it does not contain the MID.
rationale: Role assumed: security officer. What MID stands for is not given.

requirement_text: The system shall provide self-descriptive navigation, allowing users to understand their location, history, and future options within the application.
user_story: As a user, I want navigation that shows where I am, where I have been and where I can go next, so that I am not lost.
technical_task: Provide navigation that displays the user's current location, their history and the options available next.
acceptance_criteria: Given any page, when the user looks at the navigation, then the current location is shown.
Given the navigation, when the user views it, then the user's history and the future options are shown.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Self-descriptive" is read as showing location, history and options.

requirement_text: The system shall allow agents to select between unicast, multicast, and broadcast communication.
user_story: As an agent, I want to select unicast, multicast or broadcast communication, so that I can reach the right recipients.
technical_task: Let agents choose between unicast, multicast and broadcast when communicating.
acceptance_criteria: Given an agent sending a message, when the agent selects unicast, multicast or broadcast, then the message is sent in that mode.
Given the communication options, when an agent views them, then all three are offered.
rationale: Role stated: agent.

requirement_text: Maintain an audit log of tracking numbers in a file that is treated as a business record of the organization.
user_story: As a records manager, I want an audit log of tracking numbers kept in a file treated as a business record, so that it is retained like other records.
technical_task: Write tracking numbers to an audit log file and manage that file as a business record of the organization.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tracking number is used, when the action occurs, then it is added to the audit log.
Given the audit log file, when records are managed, then it is handled as a business record of the organization.
rationale: Role assumed: records manager.

requirement_text: The APAF ground data system shall have built-in error handling.
user_story: As an operator, I want the APAF ground data system to handle errors itself, so that failures are dealt with automatically.
technical_task: Build error handling into the APAF ground data system.
acceptance_criteria: Given an error occurs in the APAF ground data system, when it happens, then built-in error handling responds.
Given the system documentation, when it is reviewed, then built-in error handling is described.
rationale: Role assumed: operator. The kinds of errors are not listed.

requirement_text: The System shall allow entering, storing and modifying product formulas.
user_story: As a formulation chemist, I want to enter, store and modify product formulas, so that formulas are kept in the system.
technical_task: Implement entry, storage and modification of product formulas.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new product formula, when the user enters it, then it is stored.
Given a stored formula, when the user modifies it, then the changes are saved.
rationale: Role assumed: formulation chemist.

requirement_text: The system shall support multiple languages for user interface elements, potentially including multilingual ebooks.
user_story: As a reader, I want user interface elements in multiple languages, possibly including multilingual ebooks, so that I can use my own language.
technical_task: Support multiple languages for the user interface elements and, where possible, multilingual ebooks.
acceptance_criteria: Given the supported languages, when the user selects one, then the user interface elements appear in that language.
Given a multilingual ebook, when the user opens it, then the ebook can be read in a supported language.
rationale: Role assumed: reader. Ebook support is only "potentially" required.

requirement_text: The system shall not lose any orders or customer payments under any circumstances (P2, P3).
user_story: As a customer, I want my orders and payments never to be lost, so that I can trust the system.
technical_task: Ensure orders and customer payments are never lost, whatever happens.
acceptance_criteria: Given an order or payment is accepted, when a failure occurs, then the order or payment is not lost.
Given an order or payment is accepted, when the system restarts, then the order or payment is still present.
rationale: Role assumed: customer. "Under any circumstances" cannot be proven; the criteria cover failure and restart.

requirement_text: The procedures used to build the executable FTSS software using a cross-compiler and linker, down-load the image to the target processors, and burn the load image into the Radstone PowerPC flash RAM shall be documented in the release notes that accompany Engineering Releases of the FTSS software and in the Software Users Manual.
requirement_text_raw: The procedures used to build the executable FTSS software using a cross-compiler and linker, down-load the image to the target processors, and burn the load image into the Radstone PowerPC flash RAM shall (3.3.7.1) be documented in the release notes that accompany Engineering Releases of the FTSS software and in the Software Users Manual.
user_story: As a release manager, I want the procedures for building, downloading and burning the FTSS software documented, so that releases are repeatable.
technical_task: Document the build, download and flash-burning procedures in the release notes of Engineering Releases and in the Software Users Manual.
acceptance_criteria: Given an Engineering Release of the FTSS software, when the release notes are read, then they document the procedures for building with a cross-compiler and linker, down-loading and burning to the Radstone PowerPC flash RAM.
Given the Software Users Manual, when it is read, then it documents the same procedures.
rationale: Role assumed: release manager.

requirement_text: The solution should provide documentation on information classification matrix of all information elements accessed possibly and possibly processed by the solution.
user_story: As an information security officer, I want documentation of an information classification matrix for all information elements accessed or processed, so that information is handled by class.
technical_task: Produce documentation containing an information classification matrix for every information element the solution accesses or possibly processes.
acceptance_criteria: Given the solution documentation, when it is reviewed, then it contains an information classification matrix.
Given the matrix, when its entries are checked, then every information element the solution accesses or processes is classified.
rationale: Role assumed: information security officer.

requirement_text: The supermarket staff shall add new items to the inventory.
user_story: As a supermarket staff member, I want to add new items to the inventory, so that stock is up to date.
technical_task: Provide a way for supermarket staff to register new items in the inventory.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new item, when staff add it, then it appears in the inventory.
Given the inventory list, when staff view it, then the new item is shown.
rationale: Role stated: supermarket staff.

requirement_text: User shall be able to select a channel and view content from that channel.
user_story: As a viewer, I want to select a channel and view its content, so that I can watch what I like.
technical_task: Allow selecting a channel and then displaying that channel's content.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of channels, when the user selects one, then that channel is chosen.
Given a chosen channel, when the user opens it, then its content is shown.
rationale: Role assumed: viewer.

requirement_text: The solution should provide time stamps that are synchronized with the authoritative enterprise time server for use in audit record generation.
user_story: As an auditor, I want time stamps synchronized with the authoritative enterprise time server in audit records, so that audit times are reliable.
technical_task: Obtain time stamps for audit record generation from a clock synchronized with the authoritative enterprise time server.
acceptance_criteria: Given an audit record is generated, when it is time stamped, then the time stamp comes from a clock synchronized with the authoritative enterprise time server.
Given the audit records, when the auditor reviews them, then their time stamps are consistent with the enterprise time server.
rationale: Role assumed: auditor.

requirement_text: System shall support efficient filtering and management of trainee information for admins.
user_story: As an admin, I want to filter and manage trainee information, so that I can find and update trainees.
technical_task: Provide filters and management functions for trainee information for admins.
acceptance_criteria: Given trainee information, when an admin applies a filter, then only matching trainees are shown.
Given a trainee, when an admin edits the information, then the changes are saved.
rationale: Role stated: admin. "Efficient" is not measured.

requirement_text: The component calculates additional objects on the left and right side of the path and also an object behind the nearest object in path.
user_story: As a driver assistance engineer, I want the component to compute extra objects to the left and right of the path and one behind the nearest object in the path, so that more of the scene is considered.
technical_task: Have the component compute additional objects on the left and on the right of the path and an object behind the nearest object in the path.
acceptance_criteria: Given a path with objects, when the component calculates, then additional objects on the left and right sides of the path are produced.
Given a nearest object in the path, when the component calculates, then an object behind it is also produced.
rationale: Role assumed: driver assistance engineer.

requirement_text: The LHCP can download an XML-formatted document containing the results of the group report.
user_story: As an LHCP, I want to download an XML-formatted document with the results of the group report, so that I can use the results elsewhere.
technical_task: Add an XML download for the results of the group report.
acceptance_criteria: Given a group report, when the LHCP requests the download, then an XML document is provided.
Given the downloaded document, when it is opened, then it contains the results of the group report.
rationale: Role stated: LHCP.

requirement_text: The application shall maintain a list of classes for the user.
user_story: As a student, I want the application to keep a list of my classes, so that I can see them.
technical_task: Maintain a per-user list of classes in the application.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user, when the user adds a class, then it appears in the user's list.
Given the user's list, when the user opens it, then the classes are shown.
rationale: Role assumed: student.

requirement_text: The solution should conform to function IN.1.3 (Entity Access Control) in order for a healthcare delivery organization to manage a patient’s access to his or her healthcare information.
user_story: As a healthcare organization, I want the solution to conform to function IN.1.3 (Entity Access Control), so that I can manage a patient's access to their health information.
technical_task: Implement entity access control in line with function IN.1.3 so the organization can control who may access a patient's health information.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient's health information, when access is requested, then access is decided according to entity access control.
Given the organization, when it changes a patient's access, then the change is applied to future requests.
rationale: Role assumed: healthcare delivery organization. The content of IN.1.3 is not given; the section symbol/apostrophe in the source is garbled.

requirement_text: User passwords shall be encrypted in the database management system (DBMS) for security.
user_story: As a user, I want my password encrypted in the DBMS, so that it stays secure.
technical_task: Store user passwords in the DBMS in encrypted form.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user password, when it is saved in the database management system, then it is encrypted.
Given the DBMS contents, when someone inspects the stored passwords, then the passwords are not readable.
rationale: Role assumed: user.

requirement_text: The main window shall list buildings monitored and summarizing the current diagnostic status of all contained monitored units.
user_story: As a monitoring operator, I want the main window to list the monitored buildings and summarize the current diagnostic status of all monitored units in them, so that I see the overall state.
technical_task: Show the monitored buildings in the main window together with a summary of the current diagnostic status of every monitored unit they contain.
acceptance_criteria: Given the main window, when it is displayed, then the monitored buildings are listed.
Given a listed building, when it is displayed, then the current diagnostic status of all its monitored units is summarized.
rationale: Role assumed: monitoring operator.

requirement_text: The FTSS software shall receive telemetry commands from both CTCs via the MPCC/CTC once every medium frame.
requirement_text_raw: The FTSS software shall (3.4.2.5) receive telemetry commands from both CTCs via the MPCC/CTC once every medium frame.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the FTSS software to receive telemetry commands from both CTCs once every medium frame, so that commands are processed regularly.
technical_task: Receive telemetry commands from both CTCs through the MPCC/CTC once per medium frame.
acceptance_criteria: Given a medium frame, when it runs, then the FTSS software receives telemetry commands from both CTCs.
Given consecutive medium frames, when they run, then commands are received once in each frame.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer.

requirement_text: Further details are listed in chapter 8.6.15 EMC Requirements.
rationale: The sentence only points to another chapter.
clarification_questions: What do the EMC requirements in the referenced chapter specify?
Is the referenced chapter part of this requirement?
